Throughout the subsequent results sections, the results of the Comprehensive GHP + High Efficiency Envelope + LED Lighting package will be compared to the baseline, the Comprehensive GHP package, and the Comprehensive GHP + High Efficiency Envelope package. A summary of these three packages is as follows: - Comprehensive GHP: Packaged GHP + Hydronic GHP + Console GHP - Comprehensive GHP + High Efficiency Envelope: Packaged GHP + Hydronic GHP + Console GHP + New Windows + Wall Insulation + Roof Insulation - Comprehensive GHP + High Efficiency Envelope + LED Lighting: Packaged GHP + Hydronic GHP + Console GHP + New Windows + Wall Insulation + Roof Insulation + LED Lighting. The assumptions and applicability of the GHP measures in both packages are the same. With the application of envelope and lighting measures, we can analyze the impacts of these upgrades on both the stock level impacts of the combined technologies, as well as the sizing and performance impacts on the GHPs.
